messages:
jamie: heads-up — AcmeRetail just escalated. Their /v1/generate 95p latency spiked to ~2.3s in prod for the last 30m. They're calling this an SLA risk and want an ETA. Who can own remediation and a short-term workaround?
alert-bot: incident opened: INC-12345 (pagerduty) — high latency alerts from us-west-2.
arjun: pinging eng-runtime and eng-sre to triage. could this be related to yesterday's kernel/kv-cache change?
maya: looking now. initial traces show KV cache growth for long-seq requests (>1024) and a small set of pods hitting OOM/kvm churn. Not all pods.
tanner: eng-sre here — we can try routing traffic off the affected pod set and shift to a fallback pool. I can add a routing rule to send 25% to model-quantized fallback immediately. ETA 10m to apply.
liu: infra can spin up 4 warm nodes in us-west-2 to absorb traffic. ETA ~20m.
sofia: customer-success — I'll message AcmeRetail with a short notice: "we're investigating, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m". Please assign a single engineering owner for follow-up.
maya: i'll own the hotfix (maya). Plan: backport cache-trim patch to v1.14 that bounds KV-cache growth + set model.default_max_batch_size=8 as short-term config. PR: #4512. Canary in 2h, full rollout in 4h if canary looks good.
arjun: I'll review PR today. If we need to push an emergency hotfix release we need product approval for risk surface. ping me in #code-review when it's ready.
emma: product — I approve emergency risk review. provide a one-paragraph risk summary so I can sign off fast.
maya: risk summary: change restricts KV cache growth and reduces default batch size; low logical risk (no behavior change for normal seq lengths), perf improvement for long sequences. rollback plan: revert config + flip route back.
tanner: I'm applying the routing workaround now to shed load. executing route policy change.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: route-policy update applied by tanner at ts=1623457120 — 25% traffic -> model-quantized-v2-fallback in us-west-2.
jamie: thanks team. sofia, please update AcmeRetail with the workaround live and ETA for engineering fix (30m update, 4h full fix).
sofia: updated customer via email + shared status in their portal. they asked for clear owner; I told them maya is primary and jamie is exec contact.
arjun: tagging reviewers for PR #4512: @arjun @li @nova — please look when you can. Also need a smoke test added for cache-growth.
nova: will add a nightlies smoke that sends synthetic long-seq traffic and asserts KV cache stable.
liu: infra note — spawned 4 nodes, autoscaler adjusted. nodes show Ready at 1623457180.
maya: will push a canary to 5% after ARJUN review. ETA for canary start ~2h. If canary looks good, plan full rollout 2h after that.
tanner: monitoring dashboard updated with additional 95p alarm thresholds and an incident timeline.
jamie: once the hotfix is merged and canary looks healthy, let's close INC-12345 and send final update to AcmeRetail. Thanks for quick responses.
sofia: will prepare final customer note template.
alert-bot: note: alert rate subsided by ~15% after route change (observed at 1623457260).
jamie: follow-ups: (1) maya owns hotfix PR and canary rollout, (2) tanner owns immediate routing/workaround, (3) liu owns infra scale-up, (4) sofia owns customer comms, (5) nova adds smoke test. I'll coordinate post-mortem and timeline for next sync.
arjun: ping for code review again when PR is up.
nova: started a draft smoke test in branch test/cache-smoke; will open PR in ~1h.
sofia: sent 30m update to customer at 1623457340. they acknowledged and asked to be looped in for the final closure.
jamie: closing notes — good triage. keep this thread updated with any regression during canary."
